lines: One hundred new soldiers came up the line, and the last of them took the hill.
On the top stands a dead tree. It is not a tree. It is steel, painted like bark, and a spotter sits inside it.
For three days he watches every move in the Concord trenches. Hegemony snipers and machine gunners will shoot straighter for it.
Now the race for Blackwater Canal begins. This one is bigger. The first side to bring two hundred new soldiers takes it.
Comment HEGEMONY or CONCORD to enlist. Bring your friends to the front.
Mud and Iron. Every follower is a soldier.
